name: JTLS-GO (Joint Theater Level Simulation – Global Operations)
description: Computer-assisted wargame for joint and combined operations at the operational and theater level. Models logistics, intelligence, multi-domain joint operations, and campaign dynamics. Used by NATO, U.S. DoD, and allied nations for command staff training and campaign analysis.
reputation: long-standing NATO and U.S. DoD standard for theater-level campaign analysis and joint staff training
notes: Successor to JTLS; global operations variant extends scope to worldwide theater interactions. Supports Blue, Red, and neutral force modeling. Widely used for joint exercise support and operational planning.
